items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46019280/0ae0033d53457ec9e7750c59acf01f74e71030b2.jpg"]
Hello Investigators! Unity recently shared a couple of security advisories, and we did what a responsible game studio should do: we checked our games and applied the necessary fixes.

The issues involve some technical parts of the Unity engine, including security certificates and data handling. Nothing particularly exciting from a player's perspective, but still worth taking care of.

These are mostly small, behind-the-scenes fixes. We also took the opportunity to include a few minor bug fixes we had already prepared for our next major patch, based on issues you reported here on Discord, such as a bug with language selection.
No new content, just some maintenance and a few small improvements. Let's dive into the details:
Added a message when the player solves all cases displaying all scores
Fixed a case where it was impossible to remove vertically placed evidence markers

topNew: Added a message when the player solves all cases displaying all scores

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46019280/0354f717836c44e14d6bb3198f027ce5c86afd7c.jpg"]
Hello Investigators!
We have made another batch of fixes and improvements. We also focused on more compatability with Steam Deck and Steam Machine mostly readability issues. Let's dive into the details:
Added controller dead zones to movement and look sticks.
Added visual and audio feedback to desoldering when you heat up the chip too much.
Increased font sizes in settings & notifications for better readability on Steam Deck and Steam Machine.
Added Steam Deck specific controller glyphs.
Added an option in control settings to override which button icons are used when using a controller (PC only)
Fixed logos in credits flashing for a single frame when entering the credits.
Adjusted the digital alarm clocks to show the time from the case intro and not the local machine time.
Fixed Markers showing a wrong number for a single frame in some cases.
Fixed trajectory laser dotted line appearing for a single frame.
Fixed controller navigation for the 3rd run slot to behave as expected.
Added a flag to auto release evidences when leaving a station if the evidences are not in use by a process. Used for digital analysis stations as they had conflicts over ownership of an evidence.
Correctly detect loose chips and block decryption in the analysis station.
Additionally, we’ve decided to take the demo offline for the time being, as it no longer represents the current state of the game.
We’d like to thank everyone who tried the demo, shared their feedback, and enjoyed playing it. The feedback we’ve received has helped us tremendously throughout development and continues to do so!

topNew: Added controller dead zones to movement and look sticks.
Added visual and audio feedback to desoldering when you heat up the chip too much.

items.text: Hello Investigators. We’ve released another patch to fix an issue affecting some of the evidence in "Coin Trail" and "Blood Ties at the Poolbar." For almost everyone nothing should change and you can continue. Those of you who picked up evidence in these two cases and have an active save in those cases and have not completed the associated investigation, you might have to restart the case. On Restarting, the game will fix your run file and you should not encounter more problems with your save. We really want to give all of you a smooth experience which is why we are doing this as soon as it got reported.
Continue is now auto selected when you start up the game and you have an existing run
Adjusted leaning behavior to reduce unexpected movement
Added slow movement also to desoldering
Fixed a rare issue with some evidences causing broken saves
Fixed the send mail UI on ultra wide screens
Fixed a very rare issue on falling through the floor when selecting a case. This was already not an issue because a guard system put you right back in the lab but it looked bad for a frame or two
Fixed Markus Feldmann's fingerprint missing one specific minutia
Fixed being able to reveal a fingerprint through an object such as a table in several cases
Removed input hint setting because it was deprecated anyway

items.text: After the first patch and the progression issue under control we focused our work on the first batch of improvements and of course more bug fixes. The Biggest things are holograms of the locked cases to have an indicator what is to come. We also added a better zoom control for the DNA comparison.
This is just the first batch more is to come. Let's dive into the details:
We improved the skybox in Shooting Mishap

items.text: We noticed that a few people have trouble unlocking cases. We found a bug preventing progression in some cases. This patch fixes most issues with that. We will monitor the situation and will react fast with further fixes if needed. All of you should now be able to experience the 4 tutorials and 14 cases we made for the game.
This Patch also introduces the first batch of onboarding changes, more to come. Let's dive into the details:
Added Video Tutorials for Analysis Stations
Tutorial case summaries now list the evidence to secure (and note that real cases won't provide these lists)
Added a status icon and color to the tripod photography UI
Added a shadow to the vacuum pipette in desoldering analysis
Fixed the analysis quality average incorrectly counting non-matching evidence
Replaying a case no longer affects the unlocked-cases list
Fixed incorrectly assigned bullet information in case 10
Fixed the digital analysis results page not fitting all content in case 4
Fixed mismatch of conclusion/solving in tutorial 2
Removed nested pack IDs in the case 10 evidence trajectory prefab
